connector.name: Cloudcostsmcp
connector.registryDescription: Anchor AI FinOps to real, live cloud pricing - AWS, GCP & Azure public and enterprise rates.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package opencloudcosts. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the x7even account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: OCC_GCP_API_KEY
env.description: GCP free API key — required for GCP pricing, no billing account needed.

env.name: OCC_AWS_ENABLE_COST_EXPLORER
env.description: Set to true to enable effective/discounted AWS pricing via Cost Explorer ($0.01/call).

env.name: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID
env.description: AWS credentials — only needed for effective pricing (RI/Savings Plans). Public pricing works without credentials.

env.name: AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
env.description: AWS secret key — paired with AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID for effective pricing.

env.name: OCC_GCP_BILLING_ACCOUNT_ID
env.description: GCP billing account ID — enables effective/contract pricing via Cloud Billing API.
